text-muted.$description: Secondary text. At least 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-muted and surface-neutral.

text-placeholder.$description: Input placeholders. At least 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

surface-raised.$description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, dropdown lists, dialogs, drawers.

surface-muted.$description: Subdued fill: filled cards, striped rows, segmented-control tracks, stepper buttons.

surface-hover.$description: Hover background for items on surface or surface-raised.

surface-active.$description: Pressed background, and hover on surface-muted.

surface-neutral.$description: Neutral chips and placeholders: neutral badges/tags, skeletons, progress tracks, avatars.

surface-strong.$description: Stronger neutral fill: slider/switch tracks, spinner ring, pending stepper connector.

surface-inverse.$description: Inverted surface for tooltips and neutral toasts; pair with text-inverse.
